'''Peter Dalgaard''' (born 1959) is a Danish [[statistician]] and one of the core developers of the [[R (programming language)|R statistical programming language]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Boye|first=Magnus|date=2018-08-13|title=Dansk professor i R's Core Team: Vi har et foryngelsesproblem|url=https://www.version2.dk/artikel/dansk-professor-rs-core-team-vi-har-foryngelsesproblem-1085892|access-date=2020-11-02|website=Version2|language=da}}</ref> He is a professor at [[Copenhagen Business School]]<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-07-09|title=Peter Dalgaard|url=https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/departments-and-centres/department-of-finance/staff/pdmes|access-date=2020-11-02|website=CBS – Copenhagen Business School|language=en}}</ref> and was previously a professor of [[biostatistics]] at the [[University of Copenhagen]], where he obtained his MSc in 1985 and PhD in 1991.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Peter Dalgaard|url=http://staff.pubhealth.ku.dk/~pd/|access-date=2020-11-02|publisher=Department of Public Health, [[University of Copenhagen]]}}</ref>

Dalgaard co-edited the ''[[Scandinavian Journal of Statistics]]'' from 2016 to 2018.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Scandinavian Journal of Statistics 50th Anniversary Special Issue |url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/toc/10.1111/(ISSN)1467-9469.50thanniversary}}</ref>
